# #[ignore]d tests that are a child process's entry point, for the rust_test
# job in .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml: another test of the same binary
# starts the binary again with `--ignored --exact <name>`, so they run inside
# that test, and not as tests of their own. The job fails for an #[ignore]d
# test that no invocation runs and no list names, and for a line here that
# names no such test.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test name>  <the test that starts it>.
//crates/pi-builtins:pi-builtins_test locale::tests::the_ignored_signal_probe  an_inherited_handler_does_not_run_in_the_child_before_exec's stand-in utility
//crates/pi-builtins:pi-builtins_test proc_snapshot::tests::walk_from_a_process_named_p_377q  an_ancestor_whose_name_is_no_utf8_is_walked
//crates/pi-natives:pi_natives_test desktop::linux::x11::mpx::tests::leader_exits_first  a_live_owner_whose_leader_has_exited_keeps_its_masters and an_owner_with_only_its_exited_leader_left_is_stale (LeaderGone::start)
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test proctree::tests::a_second_thread_until_stdin_closes  threads_of_a_child_are_not_children
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test proctree::tests::a_thread_that_forked_a_sleep  a_thread_that_left_before_its_children_were_read_loses_no_child
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test proctree::tests::kill_tree_with_no_descriptor_left  kill_tree_kills_the_group_and_reports_a_walk_it_could_not_finish
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test proctree::tests::mark_never_read_with_no_descriptor_left  a_boot_id_that_cannot_be_read_never_changes_a_mark
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test proctree::tests::mark_read_again_with_no_descriptor_left  a_boot_id_that_cannot_be_read_never_changes_a_mark
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test session::tests::signal_target_with_no_descriptor_left  signals_are_refused_while_the_ancestors_cannot_be_read
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test shell::tests::process_test_sleeper  the process-control tests (shell/tests/mod.rs spawns it)
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test sys::proc::tests::ended_with_no_descriptor_left  ended_does_not_count_a_process_it_cannot_read
//crates/pi-shell:pi-shell_test sys::proc::tests::leader_exits_first  a_group_kill_reaches_a_process_whose_leader_has_exited and a_process_with_only_its_exited_leader_left_stays_a_zombie (LeaderGone::start)
